outcome: early postpartum pelvic floor muscle weakness (PFMW)
cohort: The study included primiparous women who had vaginal deliveries at a tertiary maternity hospital in Shanghai, China, between July 2021 and December 2023.
finding: The study successfully established and validated a nomogram integrating maternal and obstetric factors to predict early postpartum pelvic floor muscle weakness in primiparous women after vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Instrumental delivery (forceps) was identified as a significant independent predictor for early postpartum pelvic floor muscle weakness.
